notes: Relative budget denominators use max(|integrated boundary transfer|, |inventory change|).

a_v and k_r are declared inputs, not fitted. Absolute growth rates are therefore parameter-conditional; the verification targets are identities and convergence orders, which are parameter-independent.
No tolerance in this file validates physics. They bound implementation and discretisation error only.

The P1-R2 driven chain is a one-way diagnostic: the soil salinity trajectory it reads was produced under a FIXED prescribed evaporation flux, while this module computes a salinity-dependent flux. The two are inconsistent by construction and no feedback is claimed.
